frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Demande professeur et recherche formateur
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Developper le parcours demande professeur eleve/financeur, la gestion RP et la reponse formateur.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Teacher search results may mock profile ranking until profile statistics are stable.
Notifications can be mocked until dashboard-notification-service phase.

frontTests.item: Student creates a specific teacher request.
Financeur creates a PP change request.
RP selects candidates and status changes to candidates selected.
Client selects a candidate and request closes.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Avoid trailing-slash redirects on collection/detail routes.

definitionOfDone.item: A complete teacher request can be followed from student/financeur to RP to teacher.
No orchestration-service is required: the test drives the sequence through public APIs.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
